Legal Compliance

Ensuring STLACCESS meets global standards for accessibility, privacy, and technical transparency.

Accessibility (A11Y)

I aim to meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards. My interface is designed to be usable by everyone, including those using screen readers and keyboard-only navigation.

  • High contrast text ratios
  • ARIA labels for dynamic content
  • Semantic HTML5 structure

Data Protection

STLACCESS is fully compliant with global privacy regulations, including GDPR (EU), CCPA (USA), and UK-GDPR. The site operates with a strict zero-tracking policy, utilizing no analytics or cookies.

  • 100% Tracking-Free
  • Local-first data architecture
  • Transparent methodology

Global Validity Statement

STLACCESS is designed to be legally valid for worldwide use. By minimizing data collection and using clear and robust disclaimers, I ensure that users from any jurisdiction can use my engine with confidence.

Technical Stack

To ensure security and performance, STLACCESS utilizes the following technologies:

  • Vanilla JavaScript: No heavy frameworks to ensure maximum browser compatibility.
  • Tailwind CSS: For responsive and accessible layout design.
  • Font Awesome: For high-clarity iconography.
  • Cloudflare: For secure delivery and global availability.

Intellectual Property & Fair Use

STLACCESS is an independent mathematical tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Games Workshop Limited, Disney, Wizards of the Coast, or any other miniature manufacturer.

All brand names, trademarks, and registered trademarks (e.g., Warhammer, Star Wars Legion, Dungeons & Dragons) are the property of their respective owners. Their use on this site is for referential purposes only to assist hobbyists in scale conversion and does not imply any ownership or official connection.

Accuracy Disclaimer

While my engine uses high-precision formulas based on the 175cm human baseline, results should be used as a guide. Factors such as resin shrinkage (typically 0.5% - 2%), slicer tolerances, and individual sculptor interpretations may affect the final physical result.

Reporting Issues

If you believe any part of STLACCESS does not meet a specific legal or accessibility standard in your region, please open an issue on my GitHub repository. I am committed to continuous improvement.

STLACCESS

STLACCESS is an independent project dedicated to solving the scaling issues within the 3D printing and tabletop gaming hobby.
